
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Marktowin/p/19536935" title="发布于 2026-01-27 10:43">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">控制权限系列之（2）手把手教你使用基于角色的权限控制</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>前一篇已经分析了多种权限模型，其中比较常用的是基于角色的权限控制。</p>
<h3><strong>基于角色的权限控制</strong></h3>
<h4><strong>表设计：</strong></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">用户表
用户</span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">角色关系表
角色表
角色</span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">菜单关系表
菜单表</span></pre>
</div>
<h4><strong>权限标识格式：</strong></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>格式：xxx:xxx:xxx（模块:资源:操作） 三段式</pre>
</div>
<h4>权限架构的分层结构：</h4>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">应用层 (@RequirePermission注解)
    ↓
权限验证层 (PermissionValidator)
    ↓
权限上下文层 (PermissionContext </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ThreadLocal)
    ↓
权限提供层 (PermissionProvider </span>- 数据库/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">缓存)
    ↓
权限存储层 (PermissionStorage </span>- Redis/Memory)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>权限架构接口：</h3>
<h4>权限提供者接口</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionProvider {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取用户的所有权限标识</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getUserPermissions(Object userId);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取用户角色列表</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getUserRoles(Object userId);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查用户是否为超级管理员</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isSuperAdmin(Object userId);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 刷新用户权限缓存</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> refreshUserPermissions(Object userId);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> }</pre>
</div>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="50">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="50"><code>userId</code>&nbsp;使用&nbsp;<code>Object</code>&nbsp;类型，支持 String、Long 等不同ID类型</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="51">支持超级管理员逻辑（拥有所有权限）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="52">提供刷新接口，支持权限变更后更新缓存</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="22-%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E6%8E%A5%E5%8F%A3-permissionstorage" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="54">权限存储接口</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionStorage {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 存储用户权限信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeUserInfo(String token, UserInfo userInfo);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取用户权限信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    UserInfo getUserInfo(String token);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 删除用户权限信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> removeUserInfo(String token);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 刷新用户权限信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> refreshUserInfo(String token, UserInfo userInfo);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> }</pre>
</div>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="75">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="75">基于Token存储，支持分布式场景</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="76">支持多种存储实现（Redis、Memory、数据库等）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="77">提供刷新接口，支持权限实时更新</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="23-%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E5%8C%B9%E9%85%8D%E5%99%A8%E6%8E%A5%E5%8F%A3-permissionmatcher" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="79">权限匹配器接口</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionMatcher {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匹配权限</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> match(String requiredPermission, Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userPermissions);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 批量匹配（全部满足）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> matchAll(Set&lt;String&gt; requiredPermissions, Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userPermissions);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 批量匹配（任意一个满足）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> matchAny(Set&lt;String&gt; requiredPermissions, Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userPermissions);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> }</pre>
</div>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="97">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="97">支持多种匹配策略（精确、通配符、正则等）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="98">支持批量匹配（AND/OR逻辑）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="99">可扩展自定义匹配规则</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="24-%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B-userinfo" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="101">用户信息</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserInfo {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Object userId;                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用户ID</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> String username;                  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用户名</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Set&lt;String&gt; permissions;          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 权限集合</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Set&lt;String&gt; roles;                <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 角色集合</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> superAdmin;               <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否超级管理员</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Map&lt;String, Object&gt; attributes;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 扩展属性</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> }</pre>
</div>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="117">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="117">使用&nbsp;<code>Object</code>&nbsp;类型支持不同ID类型</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="118">提供扩展属性，支持业务字段存储</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="119">轻量级设计，便于序列化和传输</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="25-%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E4%B8%8A%E4%B8%8B%E6%96%87-permissioncontext" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="121">权限上下文</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionContext {

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getPermissions();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> }</pre>
</div>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="141">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="141">使用&nbsp;<code>TransmittableThreadLocal</code>&nbsp;支持线程池传递</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="142">提供便捷方法，简化权限判断</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="143">请求结束后自动清理，避免内存泄漏</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="26-%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E9%AA%8C%E8%AF%81%E5%99%A8%E6%8E%A5%E5%8F%A3-permissionvalidator" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="145">权限验证器接口</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionValidator {

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证所有权限（AND）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> hasAllPermissions(Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> permissions);

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> hasAnyPermission(Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> permissions);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证角色</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hasRole(String role);

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取当前用户上下文</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    UserContext getCurrentUser();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> }</pre>
</div>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="169">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="169">提供多种验证方式（单个、全部、任意）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="170">支持角色验证</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="171">统一权限验证入口</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="%E4%B8%89%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="173">实现策略</h3>
<h4 id="%E6%8A%BD%E8%B1%A1%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E6%8F%90%E4%BE%9B%E8%80%85-abstractpermissionprovider" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="222">抽象权限提供者</h4>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="225">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="225">提供模板方法，定义权限获取流程</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="226">子类只需实现具体查询逻辑</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="227">统一处理超级管理员逻辑</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> AbstractPermissionProvider <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionProvider {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getUserPermissions(Object userId) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 方法：统一处理超管</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (isSuperAdmin(userId)) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getAllPermissions();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> doGetUserPermissions(userId);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 子类实现：获取所有权限</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getAllPermissions();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 子类实现：查询用户权限</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> Set&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> doGetUserPermissions(Object userId);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h4 id="redis%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8-redispermissionstorage" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="251">Redis存储</h4>
<ol class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="254">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="254">使用Redis存储用户信息（JSON序列化）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="255">支持过期时间配置</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="256">支持Key前缀配置</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="257">异常处理和日志记录</li>
</ol>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> RedisPermissionStorage <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">implements</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionStorage {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> storeUserInfo(String token, UserInfo userInfo) {</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        redisTemplate.opsForValue().set(key, value, expireSeconds, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserInfo getUserInfo(String token) {</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> value<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> }</pre>
</div>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="296">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="296">支持&nbsp;<code>*</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>?</code>&nbsp;通配符</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="297">例如：<code>sys:user:*</code>&nbsp;匹配&nbsp;<code>sys:user:save</code>、<code>sys:user:update</code>&nbsp;等</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="298">使用Spring的&nbsp;<code>PatternMatchUtils.simpleMatch()</code></li>
</ul>
<h4 id="34-%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E8%BF%87%E6%BB%A4%E5%99%A8%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="311">权限过滤器</h4>
<ol class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="314">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="314">请求头提取Token</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="315">从Storage获取用户信息（如不存在，从Provider加载）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="316">设置到PermissionContext</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="317">请求结束后清理上下文</li>
</ol>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>过滤器流程：</strong><br><br>请求到达
    ↓
检查排除路径（登录、公开接口等）
    ↓
提取Token
    ↓
从Storage获取用户信息
    ↓（如果不存在）
从Provider加载用户信息 → 存储到Storage
    ↓
设置到PermissionContext
    ↓
继续请求处理
    ↓
清理PermissionContext</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 id="%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E6%B3%A8%E8%A7%A3-requirepermission" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="374">权限注解&nbsp;</h4>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="377">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="377">支持单个权限、多个权限（AND/OR）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="378">支持角色验证</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="379">支持自定义错误消息</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Target({ElementType.METHOD, ElementType.TYPE})
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> @<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RequirePermission {
    String value() </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> "";           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单个权限</span>
    String[] all() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> {};            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 全部权限（AND）</span>
    String[] any() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> {};            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 任意权限（OR）</span>
    String role() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> "";              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单个角色</span>
    String message() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> "权限不足";   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 错误消息</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<h4 id="aop%E5%88%87%E9%9D%A2%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="394">AOP切面</h4>
<ol class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="397">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="397">拦截&nbsp;<code>@RequirePermission</code>&nbsp;注解的方法</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="398">从PermissionContext获取用户信息</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="399">调用PermissionValidator验证权限</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="400">验证失败抛出异常</li>
</ol>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Aspect
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionAspect {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     @Before("@annotation(RequirePermission)"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> checkPermission(JoinPoint joinPoint) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         RequirePermission annotation =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getAnnotation(joinPoint);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证权限</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">permissionValidator.hasPermission(annotation.value())) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionDeniedException(annotation.message());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h3>与SpringBoot项目集成</h3>
<h4 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="423"><strong>配置类设计</strong>：</h4>
<ul class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="424">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="424">自动配置各个组件</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="425">支持条件装配（@ConditionalOnMissingBean）</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="426">提供默认实现</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Configuration
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> @EnableConfigurationProperties(PermissionProperties.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @Bean
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @ConditionalOnMissingBean
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionMatcher permissionMatcher() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> WildcardPermissionMatcher(); 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @Bean
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @ConditionalOnMissingBean
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionValidator permissionValidator(PermissionMatcher matcher) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DefaultPermissionValidator(matcher);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionFilter permissionFilter(...) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionFilter(...);

<h4><strong>使用示例：</strong></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@RestController
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> @RequestMapping("/api/user"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserController {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单个权限验证</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     @GetMapping("/list"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     @RequirePermission("sys:user:list"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ResponseEntity&lt;List&lt;User&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ResponseEntity.ok(userService.list());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 多个权限（全部满足）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     @PutMapping("/{id}"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     @RequirePermission(all = {"sys:user:update", "sys:user:edit"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ResponseEntity&lt;Void&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update(@PathVariable Long id, @RequestBody User user) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        userService.update(id, user);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ResponseEntity.ok().build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 多个权限（任意一个）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>     @DeleteMapping("/{id}"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>     @RequirePermission(any = {"sys:user:delete", "sys:user:remove"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ResponseEntity&lt;Void&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> delete(@PathVariable Long id) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        userService.delete(id);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ResponseEntity.ok().build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 角色验证</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>     @GetMapping("/admin"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span>     @RequirePermission(role = "ADMIN"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ResponseEntity&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> adminOnly() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ResponseEntity.ok("Admin only"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> }</pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@Service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserService {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    @Autowired
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PermissionValidator permissionValidator;

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!permissionValidator.hasPermission("sys:user:delete"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> PermissionDeniedException("无删除权限"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        userRepository.delete(userId);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserContext getCurrentUser() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> permissionValidator.getCurrentUser();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span>19 }</pre>
</div>
<h3 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="428">总结：</h3>
<ol class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="777">
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="777"><strong>接口抽象</strong>：所有核心功能都通过接口定义，便于扩展</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="778"><strong>分层设计</strong>：Provider → Storage → Matcher → Validator，职责清晰</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="779"><strong>上下文管理</strong>：使用ThreadLocal，支持异步场景</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="780"><strong>配置化</strong>：SQL、路径等可配置，适应不同项目</li>
<li class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="781"><strong>默认实现</strong>：提供常用实现，开箱即用</li>
</ol>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="783">按照以上设计思路，可实现一个灵活易用的权限控制框架。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="783">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="783">&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
